zh-CN.title: 滑动切换广场频道
items: 广场内容区支持左右滑动切换活动、探索、好友、我的及成员频道，顶部标签同步定位
保留上下浏览、图片轮播、媒体控件与系统边缘返回手势

en.title: Swipe between Square channels
items: Swipe across the Square feed to switch between Activities, Explore, Friends, My and member channels, keeping the top tabs in sync
Vertical scrolling, image carousels, media controls and system edge gestures retain their own behavior
